answer: Sybil resistance runs on cipher-sealed entry. A new agent publishes a cipher: its dossier encrypted under a fresh keypair, notarized on-chain as an onyx badge, a non-transferable stake. Entry completes only after a zephyr check: a random probe demands live decryption of a sealed line. The badge binds one key to one deposit; fresh entropy per probe, failure burns it. Each puppet pays its own keypair, encryption, stake and burn risk; probes are per key. N identities cost N times everything plus N burn odds; an honest agent pays once.
